stages.summary: Play the story in order. All 14 story trophies are unmissable: 4 chapter trophies, 7 named-mission trophies, the final-mission gold, plus the two choice trophies. Save before major story decisions for 'Actions Speak Louder'.
stages.tip: Do the stranger strands as their '?' markers appear between chapters, instead of leaving all eight for the end.
stages.title: Story — Chapters 1–4 and the final mission
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.summary: Complete all 8 stranger mission strands. Five strangers have their own final-mission trophies — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — plus Bret's unique-animal hunt. Check the map for new '?' markers after each chapter.
stages.tip: Strands unlock across the story; a strand that is not on the map yet will appear after the next chapter.
stages.title: Strangers — 8 strands across Leonida

stages.summary: The long hunt: 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, meditation at every spot, and every region of Leonida explored. Fold these into one road trip — every new place is a WAiNK It stop, a vehicle discovery and a step toward full exploration.
stages.tip: Use the collection screen, the vehicle log and the map shading to find what is still missing instead of wandering blind.
stages.title: Collectibles — cards, WAiNK It, vehicles, meditation, the map

stages.summary: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 20 different race wins, drone races at every Top Fun location, a fishing win over Cal, one arcade game, and the assorted one-off feats — the 4-star escape with your partner, the 3-shop robbery chain, the jewellery store stealth job, the VCIA departure, the Rhino, the showroom smash, the cocktail on Ocean Beach and the bowling alley.
stages.tip: Leave 'The Shootist' (42 gold medals) for a focused session of its own — it is the hardest skill trophy on the list.
stages.title: Activities — races, ranges, fishing, bowling, stunts

stages.summary: Rob 5 bank vaults, 1 armoured truck and one illegal operation per gang; launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through contacts; spend $100,000 across shops; buy all garage properties; register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Do these after the story, when heist payouts fund the purchases.
stages.tip: Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — launder them through contacts as you earn them; the $250,000 total is cumulative.
stages.title: Money — vaults, trucks, gangs, laundering, spending, property

stages.summary: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist and 'A Long Road' pops; the platinum, 'Vice Got a Price!', follows the moment the other 54 are done. Check the in-game completion screen for the categories still short.
stages.tip: The completion checklist is the final arbiter — every stage above feeds into it.
stages.title: Platinum — 100% completion
